item.title: Warm and windy storms bring more rain than snow to the valley
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. – Anomalous warmth has persisted across Western Wyoming with temperatures running 12ºF above normal in Jackson so far during the month of December. A storm on Wednesday produced wet snow up high, a 60 mph wind gust at the Jackson Hole Airport, and 0.79 inches of rain in the town of Jackson.
